messages:
jamie: AlderTech CISO elevated the POC to execs. They want a one-page escalation packet by EOD tomorrow. asks: SSO test tenant (Okta), completed security questionnaire, BYO-KMS integration notes, and a short pilot cost estimate. They also asked whether we support FedRAMP-low controls for their regulated dataset.

noah: copying. i'll draft the cost estimate. can we assume 80 concurrent sessions, avg 300 tokens, 200 reqs/min peak? Claire or Mika, confirm if those numbers are reasonable.

claire: numbers look fine as a baseline. quick note: FedRAMP-low has extra control mapping; we should not say "supported" without legal review. i'll flag it and propose a compliance review path.

mika: i'll own BYO-KMS and the attestation options. TL;DR: we support key wrap with customer-managed keys (fast) and a full HSM attestation path (requires vendor paperwork, 3-4 weeks). i'll include a diagram and a short PKCS#11 example if they want on-prem HSM.

security-bot: Alert: AlderTech requested ISO27001 + FedRAMP-low evidence. Internal process: initiate compliance intake (COM-3345) and provide SOC2 + pen-test report as interim artifacts. Lead time for full FedRAMP mapping: 2-3 weeks depending on legal.

noah: pricing draft: Pilot (4-week) reserved: $18k for 1x A6000-equivalent pool, overage $0.0009/token, isolation add-on +$4k/week. i'll put ranges.

claire: SSO test tenant: we support SAML + SCIM provisioning. infra-oncall, can you spin a test org if we provide an Okta admin user? also include sample SCIM stub below for their admin.

infra-oncall: Ticket created AT-5560: Okta test tenant for AlderTech. ETA 20h. Please add Okta admin email to the ticket.

mika: SCIM snippet for Okta provisioning (paste into Okta integration):
```
scim:
  group_mapping:
    dev: alder_dev_group
    research: alder_research_group
  sync_interval: 15m
```
Also note: to mirror production groups they should create a test org with representative users and groups.

jamie: good. Claire, can you start the security questionnaire? It's in the deal binder: https://redwood.internal/deals/aldertech/sec-q-v1.docx. Focus on data flows, retention, incident response, and encryption.

claire: i'll draft answers tonight and mark any engineering clarifications. ETA 19:00 PT.

mika: For BYO-KMS options i'll include two recommended pilot patterns: (A) Key-wrap: customer holds keys in KMS, we wrap/unwarp via envelope keys (fast path) (B) Proxy-mode: customer proxies decrypt requests through a narrow allowlist (higher latency, higher compliance). Describe tradeoffs.

noah: timeline proposed on the packet:
- Today: open infra ticket + start sec Q draft
- Tomorrow AM: KMS note + pricing final
- Tomorrow EOD: consolidated packet to AlderTech execs
If FedRAMP review required, add 2-3 week compliance path.

claire: FYI one blocker: if AlderTech insists on packet capture for inspection we need a signed DPA addendum and legal approval. flagging that as "possible blocker: legal".

jamie: Action items:
- claire: sec questionnaire draft (due today 19:00 PT)
- mika: KMS diagram + proxy/key-wrap options (due tomorrow 10:00 PT)
- noah: pricing estimate + pilot model (draft by tomorrow 09:00 PT)
- infra-oncall: Okta test tenant (AT-5560) ETA 20h
- jamie: assemble packet and send to AlderTech after sign-off (tomorrow EOD)

mika: adding note: if they require HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2 L2/L3) vendor paperwork is 3-5 weeks; propose key-wrap fallback for pilot.

infra-oncall: Reminder scheduled: follow-up on AT-5560 in 12h.

noah: i'll assemble the pricing slide and post a PDF here for quick review.

claire: uploading first pass of questionnaire answers to the binder, will paste the link when done.

jamie: thanks team 44d keep communication here. escalate to execs if any blocker slips timeline and i'll loop in Sales leadership.
